notes: doi:10.1074/jbc.M110.211078 (PMID 21385872) Sikora 2011 V. cholerae T2 secretome. Quote verbatim in abstract: "three hypothetical proteins encoded by VCA0583, VCA0738, and VC2298". T2S-dependent transport confirmed by proteomics; organism N16961 El Tor matches exactly.

Same paper doi:10.1074/jbc.M110.211078 (PMID 21385872). Quote verbatim in abstract: "16 new putative T2S substrates, including sialidase, several proteins participating in chitin utilization, two aminopeptidases, TagA-related protein, cytolysin". T2S substrate; organism N16961 matches.

doi:10.3389/fmicb.2011.00155 (PMID 21811488) Filloux 2011 review of P. aeruginosa secretion systems. Quote verbatim in full text: "there is only one Hxc-dependent substrate, namely LapA, known as low-molecular weight alkaline phosphatase (Ball et al.,)". Hxc is a P. aeruginosa T2SS; LapA named as its dependent substrate. Ref is a review citing primary work (Ball et al.); organism PAO1 matches.

Same review doi:10.3389/fmicb.2011.00155 (PMID 21811488). Quote verbatim in full text: "achieves the secretion of all Xcp substrates but the aminopeptidase PaAP (Michel et al.,). This is another indication of a specific interaction between the XcpP/XcpQ-like subcomplex and T2SS substrates." Xcp = P. aeruginosa T2SS; PaAP named as Xcp/T2SS substrate. Review citing Michel et al.; organism PAO1 matches.

doi:10.1128/IAI.70.11.6094-6106.2002 (PMID 12379686) Flieger/Cianciotto 2002. Quote verbatim in abstract incl. real ellipsis: "We previously showed that Legionella pneumophila secretes, via its type II secretion system, phospholipase A activities ... we identified and characterized plaA, a gene encoding a phospholipase A that cleaves fatty acids from lysophospholipids." Explicit T2SS secretion. Row organism Philadelphia-1 (UniProt Q5ZT22); Flieger work uses L. pneumophila strain 130b -> strain_diff, conserved plaA gene.

doi:10.1074/jbc.272.17.11109 (PMID 9111006) Letellier 1997. Quote verbatim in abstract: "Aeromonas spp. secrete the channel-forming protein proaerolysin across their inner and outer membranes in separate steps using the general secretion pathway." GSP = T2SS; documents proaerolysin (aerA) secretion. Paper uses A. hydrophila + A. salmonicida; row A. hydrophila ATCC 7966 matches. No PMCID but quote in abstract.

doi:10.1128/IAI.00672-15 (PMID 26169274) DuMont 2015. Quote verbatim in abstract: "the serine proteases StmPr1 and StmPr2, which were confirmed to be Xps substrates, are predominantly responsible for secreted proteolytic activities exhibited by strain K279a". Xps = S. maltophilia T2SS; confirmed substrates. Organism K279a matches exactly.

doi:10.1128/jb.179.23.7321-7330.1997 (PMID 9393696) Shevchik 1997. Quote verbatim in abstract: "PelI is an extracellular protein secreted by the Out secretory pathway of E. chrysanthemi." Out pathway = T2SS. Erwinia chrysanthemi 3937 = Dickeya dadantii 3937 (same strain, reclassified species); organism matches.
